FAIL the page if any gate is not met.

linking_rules.dense_mesh_strategy: Every page must link to minimum 8 other pages in the ecosystem. Hub pages link to all child pages. Child pages link back to hub, across to siblings, and to relevant content in other sections.
link_placement_rules: Links must be naturally integrated into content, not dumped in lists
Use descriptive anchor text including keyword variations
Distribute links throughout content (intro, body, conclusion)
Include navigation breadcrumbs at top of page
Related content section near bottom with 4-6 contextual links
Service/location grids should be actual clickable links, not just text
forbidden_linking: No linking to external sites except for booking/contact
No circular single-link patterns (A->B, B->A only)

word_count_gate.description: Every page must meet minimum word count

linking_gate.description: Every page must have required internal links
rules: Meet minimum link count per page type
linking_gate.failure_action: FAIL page generation, list missing links

facts_json_gate.description: All business data must come from facts_json

unknown_handling_gate.description: Unknown information must be flagged, never invented
rules: If data not in facts_json, flag as UNKNOWN
Do not invent specific therapist names

keyword_integration_gate.description: Keyword usage must be natural and strategic
keyword_integration_gate.failure_action: WARN, but may pass if readable

meta_tags_gate.description: SEO meta tags must be complete and optimized

content_quality_standards.tone: Professional yet warm and conversational. Emphasize convenience, quality, and authentic Balinese wellness.
content_quality_standards.voice: Expert, trustworthy, customer-focused. We are educators and service providers, not salesy.
content_quality_standards.style: Clear, scannable sections with headings. Short paragraphs. Bullet points for lists. Natural keyword integration.
content_quality_standards.uniqueness: Every page must have unique content. No duplicate paragraphs across pages. Location/service-specific details required.
content_quality_standards.value: Every page must provide genuine value to reader - answer questions, solve problems, educate, or facilitate booking.
